label: Tuist
description: Reuse and refresh sessions that are already managed by Tuist. Schlussel reads Tuist's credential files and refreshes them using Tuist's locking model.

identity.label: Server
identity.hint: Optional full server URL or host. Defaults to https://tuist.dev

script.note: Create or update the Tuist-managed session first.
Schlussel will read and refresh the stored Tuist session.
